claim: fetchOrderBook (apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts) holds a for loop that counts its page variable up from 1, asks for that page at PAGE_LIMIT, and breaks only when the page's hasMore is false; PAGE_LIMIT is 100. Checked in the comment-stripped body of fetchOrderBook only, never as a bare word anywhere in the file (F-140, ADR 0269).
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts'); p.exists() or sys.exit('cannot open apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts'); s=p.read_text(); s=re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*].*?[*]/','',s,flags=re.S)); g='export async function fetchOrderBook('; i=s.find(g); i>=0 or sys.exit('cannot open function fetchOrderBook'); b=s[i:s.find('\n}\n',i)]; from itertools import accumulate; D=list(accumulate((1 if c=='{' else -1 if c=='}' else 0) for c in b)); E=lambda k: next((j for j in range(k+1,len(b)) if D[j]==D[k]-1),len(b)); L=[(m.group(1),b[m.end()-1:E(m.end()-1)]) for m in re.finditer(r'for\s*[(]\s*let\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*1\s*;[^;)]*;\s*\1[+][+]\s*[)]\s*[{]',b)]; ok=[v for v,k in L if re.search(r'[.]page[(][{]\s*page:\s*'+v+r'\s*,\s*limit:\s*PAGE_LIMIT\s*[}][)]',k) and re.search(r'if\s*[(]\s*!\s*\w+[.]hasMore\s*[)]\s*break',k)]; sys.exit(0 if ok and re.search(r'export const PAGE_LIMIT = 100\b',s) else 1)"

claim: The order-book reader asks for its pages on /procurement/orders/history: HISTORY_PATH is that string, and every apiClient.get<OrderListPage> call in order-book.ts names HISTORY_PATH. /history keeps book reads out of the rate bucket POST /procurement/orders shares with GET /procurement/orders (rate-limit.guard.ts keys on route path, not method) (ADR 0269).
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts'); p.exists() or sys.exit('cannot open apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts'); s=p.read_text(); s=re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*].*?[*]/','',s,flags=re.S)); c=re.findall(r'apiClient[.]get<OrderListPage>[(]\s*(\w+)\s*,',s); sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'const HISTORY_PATH = \x27/procurement/orders/history\x27',s) and c and set(c)=={'HISTORY_PATH'} else 1)"

claim: readPage in order-book.ts compares every row's restaurantId with the house asked for, inside its loop over the page's rows, and throws HouseChangedError when they differ (ADR 0269).
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts'); p.exists() or sys.exit('cannot open apps/web/src/services/api/order-book.ts'); s=p.read_text(); s=re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*].*?[*]/','',s,flags=re.S)); g='function readPage('; i=s.find(g); i>=0 or sys.exit('cannot open function readPage'); b=s[i:s.find('\n}\n',i)]; from itertools import accumulate; D=list(accumulate((1 if c=='{' else -1 if c=='}' else 0) for c in b)); E=lambda k: next((j for j in range(k+1,len(b)) if D[j]==D[k]-1),len(b)); L=[b[m.end()-1:E(m.end()-1)] for m in re.finditer(r'for\s*[(]\s*const\s+row\s+of\s+orders\s*[)]\s*[{]',b)]; sys.exit(0 if any(re.search(r'if\s*[(]\s*row[.]restaurantId\s*!==\s*house\s*[)]\s*[{]\s*throw new HouseChangedError',k) for k in L) else 1)"

claim: listOrders (procurement.service.ts) orders by created_at and then by id, so rows that share a created_at keep one order across pages. OPEN: today it orders by created_at alone, and the order-book reader can only detect the instability (distinct ids below total), not prevent it. G2, handed to O4 by ADR 0269.
